mapper.insert: INSERT INTO metric_snapshot (period, metric_version, source_type, source_label, source_file, imported_at) VALUES (#{period}, #{metricVersion}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceLabel}, #{sourceFile}, #{importedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM metric_snapshot WHERE period = #{period} AND metric_version = #{metricVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO business_metric ( period, metric_version, metric_scope, metric_code, metric_name, module, dimension_key, segment, metric_value, display_value, unit, yoy, display_yoy, mom, budget, budget_gap, display_budget_gap, redline, yellowline, distance_to_redline, display_distance_to_redline, direction, source_status, product_type, channel_type, customer_type, vintage, mob ) VALUES ( #{period}, #{metricVersion}, #{metricScope}, #{metricCode}, #{metricName}, #{module}, #{dimensionKey}, #{segment}, #{value}, #{displayValue}, #{unit}, #{yoy}, #{displayYoy}, #{mom}, #{budget}, #{budgetGap}, #{displayBudgetGap}, #{redline}, #{yellowline}, #{distanceToRedline}, #{displayDistanceToRedline}, #{direction}, #{sourceStatus}, #{productType}, #{channelType}, #{customerType}, #{vintage}, #{mob} )
INSERT INTO card_definition (card_id, title, module, prompt_version) VALUES (#{cardId}, #{title}, #{module}, COALESCE(#{promptVersion}, 'v2'))
mapper.select: SELECT card_id, title, module, prompt_version FROM card_definition ORDER BY card_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scenario_baseline (period, metric_version, scenario, scenario_label, inputs_json) VALUES (#{period}, #{metricVersion}, #{scenario}, #{scenarioLabel}, #{inputsJson})
mapper.select: SELECT period, metric_version, scenario, scenario_label, inputs_json FROM scenario_baseline WHERE period = #{period} AND metric_version = #{metricVersion} ORDER BY CASE scenario WHEN 'bear' THEN 1 WHEN 'base' THEN 2 WHEN 'bull' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
